_comment: Canonical RevokedCertificate document shape. The PKI Authority (client) is the authority - it writes revocation records when certificates are revoked. Used to build Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) and check revocation status for mTLS authentication. A field mismatch breaks revocation checking and mTLS auth.
_consumers: agent (reads via client API for cert validation)

revoked_certificate._description: Certificate revocation record. Created when a certificate is revoked via the PKI Authority. The document ID is the certificate serial number. Used to generate CRLs and check revocation status during mTLS handshake.

serial.description: Certificate serial number (hex string). Used as the document ID.

revoked_at.description: When the certificate was revoked (UTC, ISO 8601 with Z suffix).
